hosts.name: chromium
checks: React StrictMode panel selects a real host File, imports through production storage, releases selected handle and shows durable completion
bounded source-specific warning review renders missing and unsupported content notices
conversation action returns the canonical thread ID to host composition
report is streamed into a verified host transfer and saved via a separate user gesture
importing the same export again for the same account creates no duplicate threads, messages or parts
importing changed source text adds a new sealed revision in the same thread while retaining the original message and raw source
imported text is searchable through the lexical index with no provider account and no semantic indexing
a malformed message record is skipped with a visible notice while the rest of the export imports and its raw source is retained
an extension offer with the wrong pairing code is rejected by the page and never shown

a paired offer is shown with its provenance, accepted explicitly, received with acknowledgements, resumed from the committed offset after an interruption, verified by digest and imported with method "extension"
repeating the same extension bundle for the same account is acknowledged and imported without duplicating history
declining an offer reports the refusal to the extension and leaves no staged bytes

a storage fault during an accepted bundle is reported to the extension as paused with its cause, the run is saved with that cause, Resume finishes it from the staged bytes without a second transfer, and the saved report shows the extension provenance and discovery counts
pause during an in-flight actual storage acknowledgment retains hidden progress without publishing a partial thread
saved run listing and warning/report access survive an actual browser-process restart
paused import resumes after an actual browser-process restart without a selected File or provider account
explicit discard removes unfinished import work while preserving already saved conversations and original files
unmount cancels active import, persists paused progress, releases selected host file and publishes no partial thread
